minimality_rule: Every retained coordinate must be two-domain exact, action-blindly recoverable, deletion-necessary, and non-mergeable under all lower-order quotient attacks.
negative_rule: A failed quotient attack is evidence for distinctness; a successful quotient attack removes or reconstitutes the coordinate rather than being patched with a new X field.
literature_rule: Drive-first novelty and custody work is downstream evidence hygiene and cannot change scientific thresholds.
paper_rule: Paper-readiness may shape documentation quality but cannot select or reinterpret scientific outcomes.
law_r2_gate: Only normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action surviving the complete frozen basis court may reopen R2.
